verify_kinds.auto: Proven by automated tests the agent writes and runs
verify_kinds.agent-check: Agent produces the artifact (doc, measurement) and checks it against acceptance
verify_kinds.manual-win: Needs a real Windows run; agent may close it only with recorded evidence from Windows
verify_kinds.manual-mac: Needs physical Apple Silicon; agent sets needs_manual_check unless it ran there
verify_kinds.human: Owner task; agents never mark these done
